Clipboard capture for test fixtures

This page saves exactly what an AI app puts on the clipboard, so the cleaner is tested against real copies. Nothing is sent anywhere, and the pasted HTML is shown as source text, never rendered.

Ask each app this, or anything similar:

Give me a short plan for launching a small website. Use a heading, some bold text, a bulleted list, a numbered list, a link to https://example.com, a small table with three columns, and at least one em dash.

  1. Pick the app and how you copied below.
  2. Copy the reply: either the app's copy button, or select the whole reply with the mouse and press Ctrl+C.
  3. Click the box below and press Ctrl+V.
  4. Press Save. Move the downloaded file into tests/fixtures/real/.

Six files in all: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, each copied both ways.



Click here, then press Ctrl+V
